s.how: Dice half a pineapple and mix with half a red onion, 1 chopped chilli, coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Serve with 230g corn chips.
Tip 150g cheese puffs, 150g pretzels and 200g chocolate-coated peanuts into a big bowl. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: the getaway with a pineapple theme
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 100ml teriyaki sauce for 30 minutes and grill. Grill 8 pineapple slices until charred. Serve over 300g steamed rice. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar in a 23cm tin and lay over 8 pineapple rings. Beat 125g butter and 125g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 175g self-raising flour. Spread over and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Turn out warm.

d.how: Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice. Add 200ml pineapple juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
